limitations: Physical-validation progress. Independent complete equilibrium, tensor, energy and raw peak are recomputed for343 native fields:342 on six shapes and three useful mesh levels, plus one full-egg pressure solve;18 pressure free-moment inputs remain unsupported. All six-shape physical refinement tails remain above the initial combined3% diagnostic. Pressure violates local compression/friction in the narrow gap and full egg. The nearest material-sheet defect is fixed with matched frozen inputs and33CPU/54CUDA module passes plus8CPU/8CUDA independent boundary-transfer passes. Synthetic contact snapshots are not a Franka/deformable-grasp validation. Initial failures, near-cancellation rejection, invalid observer assertions, unqualified displacement gauge comparisons and all source snapshots remain visible. Supported IPC sticking controls and independent bonded controls are included, with regularization and spatial error retained. Default2000-iteration egg recovery and the10000-iteration follow-up reject the elastic solve; a50000 cap converges in14583 iterations without changing the residual budget. The direct follow-up is tracked separately. The h0.06 analytic shell passes the combined tail diagnostic but geometry/volume error separation remains incomplete. Finite footprints do not establish complete physical convergence, separated error axes or full egg/interior-hotspot contact acceptance. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
